examples.prompt_excerpt:
Image 1 shows the Front-Right facade of dense green deciduous tree cluster with irregular shape located in urban gap in the landmark-centric coordinate frame. Based on that reference, what is your position relative to the landmark in image 2? Select one option and return the normalized bounding box of the landmark in image 2.

Options:

A. Back
B. Left
C. Back-Left
D. Front-Left
examples.input_summary: dense green deciduous tree cluster with irregular shape located in urban gap
examples.prediction_analysis: For the dense green deciduous tree cluster with irregular shape located in urban gap in this Landmark-relative Position Reasoning question, the target is GT option C and BBox [0.478, 0.427, 0.549, 0.511]. Across 10 available outputs, option prediction succeeds for 3/10 and landmark localization at IoU >= 0.5 for 0/10; both succeed for 0/10 (none). Semantic-only cases are Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Kimi K2.6, evidence-only cases are none, and 7/10 fail both. The split outcomes show that reference-frame reasoning and localization of the same reconstructed landmark do not yet reliably coincide.
